jobs.description: About Us | Partnering With Life Insurers To Optimize Lifetime Value Start a Demo Skip to navigation (n) Skip to content (c) Skip to footer (f) Solutions In-force Solutions Online Customer Solution Annuities Solution Why Atidot Company About Us Contact Us Careers Resources Blog Log in Start Free Elite team of Actuaries, Data Scientists, and Engineers Trusted growth with strong VCs Award-winning technology Strong partnerships with Fortune 500 companies + 40 million policies analyzed Preparing for the Future At Atidot, we look at the future, too. Atidot means fortune-telling in Hebrew, and such is our aspiration: to bring predictive analytics to transform the Life Insurance industry. Our team combines thought leaders from the insurance industry with AI experts trained in Israel’s most prestigious Intelligence units. Together, Atidot creates Optimal Lifetime Value and a great customer experience. Discover More Dror Katzav : Founder & CEO “We have made it our mission to support carriers as they step into the next era of life insurance and fulfill their customer's financial need throughout their life journey”. Dror Katzav Founder & CEO Read more Eyal Bar-Noy Vice President of Engineering General Manager Israel Read more Sreedhar Chintamaneni Vice President of Business Development Read more Sherry Chan, FSA, EA, MAAA Chief Strategy Officer Read more Hadas Egri Vice President of Finance Read more Norman Tutnauer Vice President Global Sales Read more Valentina Isakina Active Advisor Read more Liat Livnat Danesh Vice President of People Read more Founded by a team of data scientists and veteran actuaries, we work with tier one life and annuities insurers, mostly in North America and Europe. Atidot has offices in California, London, and Tel Aviv and was selected by Gartner to be 'Cool Vendor 2019' in Insurance. We encourage our employees to take initiative, be creative, express their personalities, and work with our teams. We would love to see you with us! Work At Atidot Dror Katzav Founder & CEO Before co-founding Atidot, Dror spent 11 years as an officer in the Israeli Defense Forces Intelligence Corps, working in AI and cybersecurity. He brought his knowledge and experience to the commercial world as a consultant for many Israeli startups following his military career. Ultimately, his love for data and technology drove him to build Atidot, applying his expertise and passion to providing the life insurance industry with a solution to support data-driven decision-making. LinkedIn Eyal Bar-Noy Vice President of Engineering General Manager Israel Eyal is a hands-on experienced technology leader with over 20 years of demonstrated expertise. He has a proven track record in building and maintaining high-performance teams and large-scale R&D groups leading to highly successful companies, including one that was acquired by Facebook. Eyal holds an MBA and B.Sc in Computer Science from Bar Ilan University. LinkedIn Sreedhar Chintamaneni Vice President of Business Development Sreedhar has over 20 years of corporate finance and investment experience. He joined Atidot after spending years at Guardian Life as a VP Strategy and, previously, a senior vice president of Deutsche Bank. He has closed over 150 corporate transactions, including venture capital and private equity investments, debt and equity financing, and mergers and acquisitions. LinkedIn Sherry Chan, FSA, EA, MAAA Chief Strategy Officer Sherry joined Atidot after holding the position of Chief Actuary of New York City for 7 years. She is an exceptional professional with 20 years of experience in leadership in strategic policy, operations, relationship management, and communications. Graduating from Ohio State University with an Executive MBA, Sherry quickly rose through the ranks of her field and ultimately became Chief Actuary of STRS of Ohio and later on of New York City. LinkedIn Hadas Egri Vice President of Finance Hadas brings over 20 years of experience as an economist and financial analyst to her role at Atidot. With a BA in Economics and Statistics and an MA in Actuarial Science from Haifa University, she has developed a robust expertise in financial strategy and analysis. Hadas held key roles including Company Economist at "Haifa Chemicals" and Head of the Price Proposal Division in the defense industry. Hadas's extensive background makes her an invaluable asset to the Atidot team, driving financial planning and analysis to new heights. LinkedIn Norman Tutnauer Vice President Global Sales Norman is a senior business executive with 30 years of experience in InsureTech and telecom. His experience in business is matched by an equally impressive multidisciplinary technical background in telecommunications, enterprise, FinTech, InsureTech, and more. Norman has led large, multinational sales/alliances teams for the past 30 years, with individual deals reaching over $50m. LinkedIn Valentina Isakina Active Advisor Valentina is an Ivy League and STEM-educated strategy and transformation executive, and a trusted advisor with 20+ years of global C-suite experience. She spent several years as a senior advisor in the Office of Prime Minister Tony Blair. Valentina is passionate about people, innovation and making a difference. LinkedIn Liat Livnat Danesh Vice President of People Liat has vast experience when it comes to growing businesses. Having held top positions at the Academy, Babylon, Paybox, and User1st, she has helped design and implement business operations and establish company culture policies. Liat also ran her own coaching business for over 15 years. Liat’s extensive knowledge of the management development process has helped her work with enterprise organizations. jobs.description: Solutions Start a Demo Skip to navigation (n) Skip to content (c) Skip to footer (f) Solutions In-force Solutions Online Customer Solution Annuities Solution Why Atidot Company About Us Contact Us Careers Resources Blog Log in Start Free Generate Upsell / Cross Sell Revenues Prevent Lapsation Grow Orphaned LTV Operationalize In-force Management Optimize Distribution & Product Strategy Generate Underwriting Efficiencies Assess Closed Blocks Risks Product Recommendation at the Point of Sale Understanding Policyholders 30% of customers need a high level of personalized advice. With Atidot, you can better understand individual policyholders to make sure they are properly insured. Predicting Customer Needs Atidot allows you to predict policyholders’ financial needs so you can identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities, and offer customers the right product at the right time and price. Knowing Who Will Lapse 30% of policyholders aren’t actively receiving services, which is the main reason for lapsation. Atidot tells you who will lapse, where and why so you can retain more policyholders and start saving resources immediately. Implementing a Retention Plan If you don't have a retention plan, Atidot can implement a customized outreach program to prevent lapsation, keeping more policies and valuable customers on your books. Finding the Profit Assigned policies are 2X more profitable than their non-assigned counterparts. Atidot provides an end-to-end solution to increase customer satisfaction and potentially increase the face value of their policies. Reaching the Right Customers We’ll let you know which customers need better service, and how best to reach them. To save you valuable time, Atidot also offers a comprehensive solution where we implement this service on your behalf. Going Beyond Insights Atidot goes far beyond running modules on your in-force data to produce insights. Our insights are streamlined into marketing actions and policyholder outreach, yielding new revenues at very low risk. Having an End-to-End Solution Atidot provides a complete end-to-end solution, including a bespoke CRM solution that captures all data and seamlessly connects with your legacy systems. Product Dashboards Use Atidot’s sophisticated, real-time product dashboards to understand why products are succeeding or underperforming based on parameters like geography, age groups, health conditions and more. Distribution Dashboards Renegotiate or improve your distribution agreements based on what your direct competitors are doing. Predict broker trends and understand your channels’ strengths and weaknesses to make sure you stay ahead of the curve. Optimize Your Process Gain a deep understanding of your underwriting process and optimize your placement ratio. Stay Ahead of your Competition Atidot’s customized insights will show you exactly where you are improving and where you are losing customers to your competition. On Point Estimations If you are a TPA or a BPO, accurately estimate the potential within your book of business for any purpose, with Atidot’s predictive analytics. Efficient, Real-Time Assessments Gain a deep understanding of the embedded risks as well as upsell and cross sell potential by running advanced analytics that are fast to implement and scalable. Improved profitability and credibility Improve profitability and efficiency by providing your agents and brokers with real-time recommendations for their customers at the point of sale. Real-Time Recommendations See who is underinsured compared to their peers, which policies are at risk of lapsation and what their Lifetime Value (LTV) is projected to be before they place the policy. Request a Demo Advanced AI, machine learning algorithms and technology designed to generate smart insights about your customers. The platform highlights valuable insights on our interactive dashboards and alerts you how and when to act to achieve the right results. Atidot can operationalize the platform’s insights to generate growth, seamlessly integrating with legacy systems and applying marketing campaigns and plans. Guardian and Atidot, working together, are uniquely positioned to bring 160 years of experience and underwriting knowledge together with the most modern technology to create new opportunities for consumers, our policyholders and our agents. jobs.title: Our Founder
jobs.description: About Us | Partnering With Life Insurers To Optimize Lifetime Value Start a Demo Skip to navigation (n) Skip to content (c) Skip to footer (f) Solutions In-force Solutions Online Customer Solution Annuities Solution Why Atidot Company About Us Contact Us Careers Resources Blog Log in Start Free Elite team of Actuaries, Data Scientists, and Engineers Trusted growth with strong VCs Award-winning technology Strong partnerships with Fortune 500 companies + 40 million policies analyzed Preparing for the Future At Atidot, we look at the future, too. Atidot means fortune-telling in Hebrew, and such is our aspiration: to bring predictive analytics to transform the Life Insurance industry. Our team combines thought leaders from the insurance industry with AI experts trained in Israel’s most prestigious Intelligence units. Together, Atidot creates Optimal Lifetime Value and a great customer experience. Discover More Dror Katzav : Founder & CEO “We have made it our mission to support carriers as they step into the next era of life insurance and fulfill their customer's financial need throughout their life journey”. Dror Katzav Founder & CEO Read more Eyal Bar-Noy Vice President of Engineering General Manager Israel Read more Sreedhar Chintamaneni Vice President of Business Development Read more Sherry Chan, FSA, EA, MAAA Chief Strategy Officer Read more Hadas Egri Vice President of Finance Read more Norman Tutnauer Vice President Global Sales Read more Valentina Isakina Active Advisor Read more Liat Livnat Danesh Vice President of People Read more Founded by a team of data scientists and veteran actuaries, we work with tier one life and annuities insurers, mostly in North America and Europe. Atidot has offices in California, London, and Tel Aviv and was selected by Gartner to be 'Cool Vendor 2019' in Insurance. We encourage our employees to take initiative, be creative, express their personalities, and work with our teams. We would love to see you with us! Work At Atidot Dror Katzav Founder & CEO Before co-founding Atidot, Dror spent 11 years as an officer in the Israeli Defense Forces Intelligence Corps, working in AI and cybersecurity. He brought his knowledge and experience to the commercial world as a consultant for many Israeli startups following his military career. Ultimately, his love for data and technology drove him to build Atidot, applying his expertise and passion to providing the life insurance industry with a solution to support data-driven decision-making. LinkedIn Eyal Bar-Noy Vice President of Engineering General Manager Israel Eyal is a hands-on experienced technology leader with over 20 years of demonstrated expertise. He has a proven track record in building and maintaining high-performance teams and large-scale R&D groups leading to highly successful companies, including one that was acquired by Facebook. Eyal holds an MBA and B.Sc in Computer Science from Bar Ilan University. LinkedIn Sreedhar Chintamaneni Vice President of Business Development Sreedhar has over 20 years of corporate finance and investment experience. He joined Atidot after spending years at Guardian Life as a VP Strategy and, previously, a senior vice president of Deutsche Bank. He has closed over 150 corporate transactions, including venture capital and private equity investments, debt and equity financing, and mergers and acquisitions. LinkedIn Sherry Chan, FSA, EA, MAAA Chief Strategy Officer Sherry joined Atidot after holding the position of Chief Actuary of New York City for 7 years. She is an exceptional professional with 20 years of experience in leadership in strategic policy, operations, relationship management, and communications. Graduating from Ohio State University with an Executive MBA, Sherry quickly rose through the ranks of her field and ultimately became Chief Actuary of STRS of Ohio and later on of New York City. LinkedIn Hadas Egri Vice President of Finance Hadas brings over 20 years of experience as an economist and financial analyst to her role at Atidot. With a BA in Economics and Statistics and an MA in Actuarial Science from Haifa University, she has developed a robust expertise in financial strategy and analysis. Hadas held key roles including Company Economist at "Haifa Chemicals" and Head of the Price Proposal Division in the defense industry. Hadas's extensive background makes her an invaluable asset to the Atidot team, driving financial planning and analysis to new heights. LinkedIn Norman Tutnauer Vice President Global Sales Norman is a senior business executive with 30 years of experience in InsureTech and telecom. His experience in business is matched by an equally impressive multidisciplinary technical background in telecommunications, enterprise, FinTech, InsureTech, and more. Norman has led large, multinational sales/alliances teams for the past 30 years, with individual deals reaching over $50m. LinkedIn Valentina Isakina Active Advisor Valentina is an Ivy League and STEM-educated strategy and transformation executive, and a trusted advisor with 20+ years of global C-suite experience. She spent several years as a senior advisor in the Office of Prime Minister Tony Blair. Valentina is passionate about people, innovation and making a difference. LinkedIn Liat Livnat Danesh Vice President of People Liat has vast experience when it comes to growing businesses. Having held top positions at the Academy, Babylon, Paybox, and User1st, she has helped design and implement business operations and establish company culture policies. Liat also ran her own coaching business for over 15 years. Liat’s extensive knowledge of the management development process has helped her work with enterprise organizations.
